name: us-form-1040-nr-nonresident-return
description: Compute a nonresident alien's 2026 U.S. income tax on Form 1040-NR. Covers who must file, the split between effectively connected income (taxed at the section 1 graduated rates after connected deductions) and U.S.-source FDAP income that is not effectively connected (30 percent, or a lower treaty rate, on the gross amount, with no deductions), the section 871(d) election for U.S. real property income, the bar on the standard deduction, dual-status years, and the section 6013(g) choice to be taxed as a resident. Trigger on "Form 1040-NR", "nonresident alien return", "effectively connected", "FDAP", "Schedule NEC", "dual-status alien", "30 percent withholding". Day-count residency is in us-tax-residency. Gain on a U.S. real property interest is in us-nonresident-cgt. Federal only.
